# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Release/deployment

## Scope

Affected areas:

- [ ] `client`
- [ ] `server`
- [ ] `docs`
- [ ] `.codex`
- [ ] `.github`

## Verification

- [ ] Tests run:
- [ ] Build run:
- [ ] Manual checks:
- [ ] Skipped checks with reason:

## Quality Gates

- [ ] Change matches `docs/architecture/project-ssot.md`.
- [ ] No production code changed unintentionally.
- [ ] No unimplemented backend API is claimed.
- [ ] User input and error states are handled.
- [ ] Accessibility was considered for UI changes.
- [ ] Performance was considered for heavy processing or bundle changes.
- [ ] Security was considered for input, files, dependencies, or server changes.

## Documentation

- [ ] SSOT updated if project truth changed.
- [ ] API docs updated if backend behavior changed.
- [ ] Patchnote/knowledgebase update offered for meaningful changes.
- [ ] No documentation update needed.

## Screenshots Or Evidence

Add screenshots, recordings, logs, or command output summaries when useful.
